hypothesis: Enable a fixed5% span prior blend only when supplied prior has reproducible span signal and no large floor atom; challenge with sparse-but-span-predictable and positive-background counterexamples.
development_evidence: Prior span holdouts and earlier720 artificial cases informed this hypothesis. This fresh stress is not whole-system blind.
gate: Twofold weak-prior-entry CV_R2>=0.2 and fraction within1e-12*max(median,1) of minimum<=0.01; inputs are supplied prior and geometry only. Fixed alpha.05 if enabled,0 otherwise.
noise_calibration: Use EXACT QR-selected count rows and additive component normalizer from registered train covariance audit; old full-row convention is not pooled. Other noise amplitudes unchanged; positive-background noise adds0.2/0.8 times truth mean with lognormal positive background.
selection: No test tuning of thresholds, alpha or families. Report all failures, every harm, original and three new counterexample shapes. Baseline remains frozen.
scope: Artificial sensitivity and public-input gate diagnostics only. No real hidden path labels, no official S_od/S_ODME claim, no Kaggle uploads.
